disposition_records.T11-UNDERIVED-TOLERANCE: The CI recipe's 18 correctness failures were legitimate FP32 rounding judged against an underived 1e-6. They are replaced by per-route worst-case bounds gamma_k = k*u/(1-k*u), u = 2^-24 (generic D+9, vDSP D+3, optimized D/16+7/8, SoA D/4+5, plus N-1 for the summed statistic, composed with the gamma64 reference error and a 2^-40 margin). An exact binary32 emulation independently reproduces the recorded maxRel (independent Opus review).
disposition_records.T11-ZERO-REFERENCE-CLASS: relErr = |c-r| / max(|r|, 1); matrix routes use absolute-error gates. Closed mechanically by 3 BenchmarkCorrectnessPolicyTests plus a regex source check (fix 1 M-4, with bypass and must-pass fixtures).
disposition_records.T11-MISSING-VALIDATION-POLICY: Per-case validation policy: noop/mem.alloc/pool/fill are declared N/A. The route ratchet covers every route and fails closed (fix 1 M-3): 11 unvalidated routes are pinned, and their suites must record no comparison.
disposition_records.T11-CI-RECIPE-EXIT: The recipe needs --samples 5, because a single sample has no median and the comparator exits 2 on a missing statistic. Correctness failures: 0. Exit 2 is closed. Exit 1 remains as timing noise on a loaded host: 4 pairs of the same binary showed 2-7 parallel/automatic regressions above 10%. The guide documents this and says to compare on a quiet host. Ruling: spec item 4 is met in substance.

limitations: The thresholds are worst-case bounds, 8e-6 to 2.5e-4 depending on the route. A defect smaller than its route's threshold, such as one small dropped term, can pass: in the review's single-host analysis a dropped term was missed 5-48% of the time at CI sizes. For the summed statistic at N of about 3,600 or more, no sound FP32-sum gate can detect a dropped candidate.

Per-distance comparisons on provider routes are held to the summed-observation bound (ProviderObservations.combining uses max(), which is fingerprinted). The 512 optimized-Euclid overload records only the observation, so its per-distance outputs are not gated.
The vDSP and cblas bounds assume binary32 inner products in some order (UNVERIFIED Accelerate assumption).
20 routes keep empirical thresholds; dist.dot.768.generic sits at 0.87 of its 1e-6.
